pose: Directly facing the camera in a symmetrical, upright 'pillar' stance. The head is perfectly centered at the top edge of the 1024px frame, and the feet are at the very bottom. The arms are tucked neatly against its sides and the tail is hidden directly behind the legs to keep the horizontal width under 300px, ensuring it remains perfectly centered for the 340x140px vertical crop.
